fields.title: 📖 Do not forbid the good things that Allah has permitted
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah forbids the believers to forbid the good things that He has permitted them, and He warns against transgression.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Personal abstinence is not the same as Tašrīʿ. It becomes dangerous when what is permitted is forbidden in the name of the religion.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:87.
